cues: When you derive the pendulum formula, always state the assumption: small amplitude, so that sine theta is approximately theta in radians.
Examiners give a mark for that line.
For large swings, the motion is still periodic, but it is no longer simple harmonic, and the real period is longer.
text: Exam tip. When you derive the pendulum formula, always state the assumption: small amplitude, so that sine theta is approximately theta in radians. Examiners give a mark for that line.
